sourceTask.excerpt:
# PLATFORM-007 — complete construction definitions

PLANNED after local recovery and grounded Knowledge delivery. Adopts the Sol/high
core proposal `.brain/evidence/platform-007-core-proposal-02.md` under existing
local full-build authorization and core priority. No implementation/test result is
claimed and this is not the current mapped task.

Deliver full ProductDefinition import/edit/preview/save/export/build. The complete
JSON is authoritative, with convenient identity/description/version/layout/module/
binding controls. composeDraft supplies only a New composition starter. Preserve
all supported fields, exact module versions and binding instanceId/scope/mode/
implementation/consumer/contract/wiring. Normalize semantic ordering, not source
whitespace. Derive choices and graphs from manifests and reviewed solutions.

Unsupported declarations remain visible as diagnostics, never silently rewritten;
reject preview/save/build when invalid. A validated HTTP binding does not become
locally launchable. Shared pure parsing/validation/serialization/preview lives in
composition/Studio source and browser catalogue bundles, not a second policy list.

Add fixed exact GET /platform-api/products/<id>/<version> and read-only POST
/platform-api/products/preview with {product}. Reuse the existing confirmed save,
immutable version, build/register/promote/runtime controls. Save the exact validated
definition under explicit id@version confirmation: equality is idempotent;
different same-version input conflicts; choosing a new version is explicit. Saving
does not rewrite maintained source files.

Paired Studio provides full import/edit/export/saved-version/graph behavior. Offline
OPEN_PLATFORM uses the same browser composition helpers through build-visual and
supports file input/edit/preview/download without filesystem/build/network powers.
Edits, imports or catalogue changes invalidate old preview/confirmation. Responses
bind draft generation, original session generation and request sequence.

Minimum checks: full round trip with description/new version/nondefault binding;
unsupported input diagnostics without rewriting; actual paired preview/save/new
version/conflict → exact build; stale result cannot enable an earlier draft save;
offline fields preserved with no API calls. Fresh build, required npm test, exact
independent review and ordinary browser journey remain separate evidence. Defer
general multi-version catalogue, signing, extension installation, destructive
uninstall and broad compatibility/fault/stress campaigns.

Root owns Brain, one Luna/xhigh implementation writer, Sol/high planning/review.
No external repositories, credentials, entitlements, spending, deployment or global
configuration. Freeze the exact candidate before final checks; preserve all earlier
failure/blocked history and truthfully scoped qualification.

Activation — 2026-10-01: CP6 accepted bounded local core at .brain/evidence/platform-006-result-01.json. Current mapped task is now PLATFORM-007 READY; finite16 source manifest is canonical contract. Scratch proposal remains unexecuted until authorized application after coordinated Brain-only build boundary.
